query:
SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('constraint',constraint_row.conname,
 'child',constraint_row.conrelid::regclass::text,'parent',constraint_row.confrelid::regclass::text,
 'delete',constraint_row.confdeltype,'deferred',constraint_row.condeferrable,
 'initially_deferred',constraint_row.condeferred,
 'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(constraint_row.oid)) ORDER BY constraint_row.conrelid::regclass::text,constraint_row.conname),'[]')
 FROM pg_constraint AS constraint_row WHERE constraint_row.contype='f'
 AND constraint_row.confrelid IN ('workflow_runs'::regclass,'workflow_executions'::regclass,
 'workflow_root_budgets'::regclass,'workflow_run_budgets'::regclass,'workflow_run_parents'::regclass,'background_tasks'::regclass)
